title: dvb-data-mpe: Decode MAC address, don't process scrambled data
description:
Use FT_ETHER for the MAC address, unless the scrambling bits are set,
in which case use a FT_BYTES field. Don't put the address in a separate
tvb, so the bytes it is extracted from can be highlighted. Don't decode
the payload if the payload scrambling bits are set. Add value_strings and
expert infos.

notes.body: Here's a toy capture that I generated with TSDuck: [mpe_modified.pcapng](/uploads/96948cf57327c9c5b00e7a3df7dab2c4/mpe_modified.pcapng). I then hexedited the scrambling and reserved bits in different MPE sections in packet 2.
